$comment: Every owl in the game, and the whole of what makes one different from another. Adding a variant is an edit HERE plus the npc_id a level spawns - never a code change. scripts/entities/npc/math_challenge_component.gd reads these fields and nothing else.

fields.id: what a level spec's npc_id points at
fields.spriteKey: sprite_registry.json key; the path and frame grid live there
fields.behavior: which component set to build; 'math_challenger' is the only one
fields.components[math_challenge].problemCount: how many questions this owl asks before it is freed. MUST equal behaviorConfig.chainLinks - the chain across the perch is how a child reads the cost from across the screen, and test_owl_chains.gd enforces the pair.
fields.components[math_challenge].difficultyRan: [low, high] band this owl draws from - the easier/harder dial. Intersected with the level's mathGating band; the curriculum ladder still owns how hard within it.
fields.components[math_challenge].problemTypes: which operations this owl may ask about at all. Intersected with the level's gated skills.
fields.behaviorConfig.chainLinks: how many links are drawn across the perch. See problemCount.
fields.behaviorConfig.rewardType / rewardAmount: what breaking the last link pays out
fields.note: why this variant exists, for whoever places it

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: Mid band, one answer. The roadside default, and what a level spawns unless it wants a specific shape.

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: One answer, easiest band. For the opening beat of a world, or after a run of misses.

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: One answer, harder band. A spike without costing time.

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: Two links. Costs more time than difficulty.

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: Three links. A set piece, not a roadside owl - it stops the run for a while.

npcs.name: Professor Hoot
npcs.note: Three links at the hardest band. Reserve for a world's final owl.
